title: Punchy Sound Translation
sonic_description: Punchy, impactful sound with fast transient and strong attack
why: Instant attack emphasizes transient. Short decay creates punch rather than sustain. Filter envelope adds movement to the attack phase. Low sustain ensures sound decays rather than sustains.
how_to_apply: Use for bass, leads, and percussive sounds. The key is instant attack and short decay. Filter envelope with fast attack adds harmonic movement to the transient.
